title: Dad's Empty Car Leaves Every DAWN 🚗
premise: In our town your car drives itself to wherever you'd rather be and everyone can see it, and my dad's car leaves our driveway empty at 5:40 every morning and comes back with a muffin on the dash.
twist: Last spring Dad drove past a young cook walking to work in the rain and didn't stop, and wished he had, so every morning since his car has gone to pick the cook up for him.
world: A mint-green bungalow at the top of a hill street at sunrise, a teal hatchback in the driveway, a long hill road through green fields to a low stone wall, and a cherry-red diner.
